user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Websites crawled for search features and navigational links in ChatGPT.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited upon user request when asking questions or using GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Enhances generative AI model utility and safety through public web training data.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt to prevent user-directed content retrieval.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt to prevent indexing for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information to build Google's search indexes and perform analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google features and products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl news content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl shopping pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform crawls for Search testing tools and diagnostics.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools including Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawl of publicly accessible content for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites for internal research and development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across websites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across websites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Execute crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content use for training Gemini models and search grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini model training for Gemini Apps and Vertex AI, plus grounding queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt for User-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web search indexing for Spotlight, Siri, and Safari, plus generative AI training context.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls whether website content is used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines training usage for foundation models powering Apple Intelligence; does not crawl pages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display preview information.
user_agents.scope: Content from apps or websites shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow in robots.txt; security checks may bypass it.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for business and advertising products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and indexes content to improve products.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training AI models or direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links requested by users and improves agentic AI.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search index and Microsoft Copilot grounding.
user_agents.scope: Standard web crawling across the public internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshot previews for Bing search results.
user_agents.scope: On-demand page fetching for snapshot generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Host-level web crawling to improve products and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level noarchive robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services without generative AI training.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to appear in search experiences like Alexa.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level noindex and none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live web information to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetching initiated by users; does not crawl for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler collecting web data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls a randomly selected sample and subset of the public web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or join the opt-out registry.
